state.name: run.number
state.description: PROFILE, survives new games. Which turn of the cycle this run is. Incremented when an ending resolves.

state.name: run.hunt_group
state.description: Which authored guest group arrives in Act 3. Odd runs b (Noor, Wes, Ana), even runs c (Sol, Rosa, Kit). Set at new game from run.number.

state.name: shelf.generations
state.description: PROFILE, survives new games. One entry per guest who went onto the shelf at the end of a run. The next run's cabin builds its shelf, guestbook and four of its Act 1 incidents from the last run's entries.

state.name: shelf.previous_ending
state.description: PROFILE. The ending of the previous run; changes small details of the next run's Act 1.

state.name: book.carried
state.description: PROFILE. Spreads of the hand-sewn book translated in any earlier run. They start this run already in order.

state.name: player.name_written
state.description: The player wrote a name in the cabin guestbook (c01). The name itself is stored as save text and becomes the 'My name' memory.

state.name: act1.unease
state.description: Guest-half tension. Keep +10, Shelve -10, incidents +5 to +15. Sets Act 2 starting hunger (10 + unease / 5).

state.name: explanation.current
state.description: The explanation the player chose to shelve the last incident. The next incident plays the variant that breaks it.

state.name: explanation.house_broken
state.description: 'It's the old cabin' has been broken and is crossed out in the journal.

state.name: explanation.us_broken
state.description: 'One of us is doing it' has been broken.

state.name: explanation.wild_broken
state.description: 'It's the forest, an animal' has been broken.

state.name: explanation.me_broken
state.description: 'I'm tired, I imagined it' has been broken.

state.name: incident_log
state.description: Each Act 1 incident and how the player answered it: response is shelve or keep.

state.name: memory.earned
state.description: Memory tokens earned in Act 1 (6 guaranteed, 16 possible) plus 'The door' in Act 2.

state.name: memory.kept
state.description: Memories currently packed in cotton slots. Read by the Warning ending and the memory governor.

state.name: memory_log
state.description: Every memory token earned, packed, moved or lost (event: earned, packed, lost).

state.name: book.pages_found
state.description: Loose hand-sewn pages found, 0 to 12.

state.name: book.spreads_read
state.description: Spreads translated, 0 to 6, including carried ones.

state.name: book.spread_1
state.description: Summoned. Effect: the shared pulse shows each friend's hunger as a glow.

state.name: book.spread_2
state.description: Bound. Effect: one Stuffing slot is a bound slot that costs cannot take.

state.name: book.spread_3
state.description: Fed. Effect: hunger is shown as a number, not only as warmth at the edges.

state.name: book.spread_4
state.description: Kept alive. Effect: Stitchwork tension band 20 percent wider.

state.name: book.spread_5
state.description: The filling. Effect: guests' dread shading, the flee line and the seal clock are visible.

state.name: book.spread_6
state.description: The keeper's hand (added). Effect: with all six read, the altar offers the stitch.

state.name: strap.quality
state.description: How well the player mended Marcus's pack strap (c01). Strong adds a line in the labyrinth.

state.name: seams.slots_total
state.description: Slots across the six seams, set by Stitchwork at waking (1 to 3 per seam) plus later mends.

state.name: seams.warm_slots
state.description: Slots not holding a memory. Each adds 15 percent to the hunger rate; a game needs one in its seam.

state.name: seams.bound_used
state.description: A memory sits in the bound slot granted by spread 2.

state.name: altar.choice
state.description: At the ritual room altar. 'stitch' is offered only with all six spreads read; 'stitched' is the novel's path.

state.name: hunger
state.description: The player's hunger. Rises while holding still near guests; at 100 the toy lurches.

state.name: hunger.lurches
state.description: Involuntary lurches. Each costs two memories.

state.name: slips
state.description: Moves or shakes a guest saw. Each seen move costs one memory.

state.name: pack.hunger.jamie
state.description: Jamie's hunger; when it reaches 100 he slips on his own.

state.name: pack.hunger.lila
state.description: Lila's hunger.

state.name: pack.hunger.marcus
state.description: Marcus's hunger.

state.name: pack.hunger.dani
state.description: Dani's hunger.

state.name: act2.jamie_fell
state.description: Scripted: Jamie falls from the shelf in c07, as written.

state.name: act2.door_held
state.description: At the bedroom door in c08 the player held still for the full surge instead of letting go. Earns the 'The door' memory.

state.name: dread.guest_1
state.description: Act 3 guest 1 (Noor or Sol).

state.name: dread.guest_2
state.description: Act 3 guest 2 (Wes or Rosa).

state.name: dread.guest_3
state.description: Act 3 guest 3 (Ana or Kit).

state.name: dread.group
state.description: Average of the three. At 70 or more before the seal, the group flees.

state.name: blame
state.description: How far the guests blame each other. At 50 or more, half of non-personal dread becomes blame. Reset at the seal.

state.name: governor.clips
state.description: Times the ritual's rhythm clipped dread at 69 because memory.kept was under 5 before the seal.

state.name: hunt_log
state.description: One entry per hunt game (sound, movement, scent, proximity, chase): whether the player joined, the dread they caused, memory after. The per-night meters the endings read.

state.name: guests_fled
state.description: The Act 3 group drove away before the seal.

state.name: seal.done
state.description: 06:00 on the third morning: doors and windows no longer open.

state.name: guests.herded
state.description: Guests who reached the ritual room in the Chase, 0 to 3.

state.name: parlour.personal
state.description: Personal tampers placed on the parlour board (a guest's peg on the symbol that is theirs).

state.name: friend.seam_mended
state.description: Which friend's torn seam the player mended in c12. That friend's hunger rises 30 percent slower.

state.name: elders.present
state.description: Run 2 and later: last run's group sits on the shelf as elders who slip on their own.

state.name: elders.slips
state.description: Slips by the elders in Act 3 (run 2 and later).
